verdict.rationale: The MI325X comes with a large first-party software ecosystem (ROCm, AMD SMI, GPU Operator, Spur scheduler, docs), so an official MCP server for docs or GPU management is a plausible offering and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an AMD MCP server, though. The llms.txt file and the absent OpenAPI spec are adjacent agent-readiness signals, not an MCP server.
